responsibility: Declares the NetBSD ELF-only driver options -rdynamic and -rpath=. It exists as the option-table companion to netbsd-elf.h so those ELF-linker-related spec options can be parsed and passed through GCC’s generated option machinery.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/netbsd-elf.h, which implements the ELF NetBSD policy through STARTFILE_SPEC, ENDFILE_SPEC, LINK_SPEC, and extra specs, this file is only the option-table entry set for the ELF-only switches -rdynamic and -rpath= so the driver can parse them.
